  • Pro since 2021, made UFC debut in November 2024
     
  • 100% finishing rate: seven wins by KO, two by submission (2 guillotine)
     
  • Seven first-round finishes, two second-round finishes
     
  • Four finishes in 1:40 or less
     
  • Former D-1 wrestler, wrestled two years at the University of Maryland (2017-2018 & 2018-2019)
     
  • Maryland State High School Wrestling Champion (Laurel HS)

UFC 330 (8/15/26) Abdul-Malik was submitted by Dustin Stoltzfus via rear-naked choke at 4:25 of the second round

UFC Fight Night (3/28/26) Abdul-Malik was stopped by Yousri Belgaroui via strikes at 3:39 of the third round

UFC 323 (12/6/25) Abdul-Malik submitted Antonio Trocoli via guillotine choke at 1:09 of the first round

UFC Fight Night (6/14/25) Abdul-Malik fought to a majority draw vs Cody Brundage

UFC Fight Night (2/22/25) Abdul-Malik stopped Nick Klein via strikes at 3:24 of the second round

UFC Fight Night (11/9/24) Abdul-Malik stopped Duško Todorović via strikes at 2:44 of the first round

 

Dana White's Contender Series, Season 8

Episode one (8/13/24) Abdul-Malik stopped Wes Schultz via strikes at 3:55 of the second round

Biggest difference in training for this fight? No difference; just a different location for competition

When and why did you start training for fighting? Six years old, because I wanted to be a Ninja Turtle

What has been your toughest fight to date and why? The man in the mirror, because I fight him every day with no breaks

Who is your favorite fighter and why? Rory MacDonald, because of the way he expresses himself outside of fighting versus inside the cage 

Did you go to college and if so what degree did you earn? University of Maryland
